correctness.rationale: Every circular word with critical exponent below \(\frac{20}{11}\) must have a linear representative with no factor above that exponent, so it lies in the exhaustively generated threshold language. Two independent generators agree on all levels and give \(3042\) length-\(22\) candidates. Two independent circular-exponent scans agree for every candidate; the exact minimum is \(\frac{20}{11}\), attained by \(132\) labeled words. Rotation canonicalization gives six classes, and exact symmetry computation gives one orbit.
